# Three meristems

<!-- STEP id="three" -->
## Where each one is

Plants have three types of meristematic tissue: apical, lateral and intercalary.

| Meristem | Where it is | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Apical | At the tips of roots and shoots | Makes the root and stem longer |
| Lateral | In a ring along the circumference of the stem | Makes the stem thicker |
| Intercalary | At the base of an internode, or just above a node, in plants such as grasses | Helps the plant grow again after cutting |

<!-- STEP id="together" -->
## Working together

**Together, these meristems give a plant its growth in length, in girth and in branching.**
